# harness

The engineering page at `/website/harness` — the right fork of the homepage.

It asks one question ("What does software engineering look like when no human
reviews the code?") and owns the `WebsiteHarness.Section` slot the answer will
be written into. The page itself contributes no section: the body is the
question and the slot, so writing the answer means adding a plugin, never
editing this one.

The nav link is contributed into the shell's shared `WebsiteHeader`, so the
shell never names this page.
